notes: The Eighth Line (credits). templates\credits_template.flp = flight_template2 with Meadow Flute on flute_md (insert 6), the struck Analog Harp on harp_struck (insert 2) and a clone bell_struck on insert 1 for the bell, Ah Voice on choir (insert 4), 12 Low Strings on strings_hi (+12, insert 5), brass_low (bass, +12, insert 8) and a clone cello_str (+12, insert 3). v3 (review v1/v2 MAJOR: the close stopped, then ended on a thin pluck): templates\credits_template2.flp adds Fruity Reeverb 2 'Large Hall' after the Pro-Q on inserts 2 (harp), 4 (choir) and 5 (strings); the score's last bars thin out (bass, strings, then the choir at the end) under two harp rolls; gains strings -8.4, choir -9.4, harp +0.6 (the reverb added 1.4-3.2 dB), Pro-L trim +1.0 (projects\credits_v3e.flp).
